summary: You present a relevant mission for the Great Barrier Reef and identify conservation and marine scientists as users. The weekly Gantt chart and STK tutorials show planning, but there are no technical design results yet. To strengthen the report, quantify mission requirements, correct the orbit concept, test sensing and coverage feasibility, and provide a more complete source plan and citations.
next_steps: In “Mission Concept & Rationale,” define measurable coverage, revisit, resolution and delivery requirements for the identified users. Correct the claim that a 600 km orbit is geostationary, and assess whether the proposed sensor and orbit can detect the target through water, cloud and turbidity at the claimed revisit and delivery rate. Distinguish thermal stress, the principal direct driver of mass bleaching, from acidification, and support and qualify the reported bleaching and mortality figures.

Build on Image 1 and the task descriptions in “Project Plan & Preliminary Progress” by adding dependencies, dated milestones and contingencies for delays or changed design choices. Specify the sources you will use—such as relevant scientific literature, mission data and technical references—and link them to the design tasks. These additions would help move C2 from Adequate to Accomplished.

Turn the STK tutorials noted in “Project Plan & Preliminary Progress” into mission-specific technical outputs: for example, compare feasible orbits and model coverage or revisit, then report and interpret results. Check the orbit assumptions before presenting outputs. Including useful preliminary results would move C3 from Deficient to Adequate and demonstrate progress toward the full design.

criteria.C1: You identify conservation and marine scientists as users and explain the reef-monitoring benefit. For Accomplished, define measurable mission objectives and requirements, support and qualify bleaching claims, and show how feasible sensing and coverage meet user needs.
criteria.C2: Image 1 gives a workable week-by-week schedule, and the task descriptions connect to launch, orbit and communications work. For Accomplished, add dependencies, dated milestones, contingencies and specific information sources that explain how the plan supports this mission.
criteria.C3: You report completing STK tutorials, but there are no mission-specific calculations, simulations or interpreted results; the stated 600 km geostationary orbit is incorrect. For Adequate, provide at least some valid technical outputs and explain what they show.
criteria.C4: Clear headings, readable prose and the labelled Gantt chart make the report understandable. For Accomplished, use complete, consistent citations instead of bare URLs, explain the chart’s deadline markers with dates, and present scientific claims precisely.
